purpose: Teach: 毛沢東/ホークス/バーゲン/ダービー/ペナルティ/ガンバ/レーガン/プリンス

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが毛沢東時代の歴史を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was teaching me about Mao's era in Chinese history.
lines.style: Gentle, almost thinking aloud. Warm observation—sharing something that struck her. Soft delivery, unhurried. A mother noticing what her husband does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとホークスの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the Hawks game together!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. The excitement of inclusion—wanting her to know he was there, that it mattered. Small boy's genuine enthusiasm, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバーゲンで靴を買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad picked up new shoes for you on sale.
lines.style: Pleased but understated. A small kindness she's noticing—not over-explaining. Warm tone, practical warmth. The satisfied exhale of a mother seeing her family cared for.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとダービーの中継観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Derby broadcast with Dad!
lines.style: Fresh energy—another moment to share. The need for her to know he was included, wanted. Quick, bright, genuine. Still eager, still young.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカーのペナルティの本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me that book about penalty kicks in soccer.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation. She's reflecting on something he shared—noticing the specificity of his interests. Slower pace, genuinely thoughtful. Almost to herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとガンバの応援グッズ買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought Gamba supporter gear together!
lines.style: Proud, bouncing energy. He's announcing something that means belonging—being part of something with his father. Eager and genuine, building on the thread.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレーガン政権時代の経済の本を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was reading about the economy during the Reagan administration.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. She's observing him in his own world—noticing what holds his attention. Measured, reflective pace. A mother seeing her husband as his own person.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプリンスホテルのレストラン行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to go to that restaurant at the Prince Hotel with Dad.
lines.style: Wistful, wanting. A small boy's wish—specific, tender. Not demanding, more like dreaming aloud. Soft, hopeful close. The vulnerability of wanting something shared.
